title: Isomorphism invariance of coherent formal modules
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X and ideal sheaf I, if F is a coherent formal module and e : F ≅ G is an isomorphism of inverse systems, then G is coherent formal.

lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModules_of_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) {F G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules} (e : F ≅ G) (hF : IsCoherentFormalModule I F) : IsCoherentFormalModule I G
